task.title: Reutilizar ejemplos API DevOps y plantillas de entorno
task.shortdesc: Use environment templates neutrales, fragmentos curl, multipart samples y Python assertions compactas para los workflows API actuales de BPM.

prereq.p: Defina BPM_BASE_URL para la instancia BPM bajo prueba. No coloque credentials, tenant names, host names personales, private hosts ni production profile IDs en reusable examples; BPM 0.9.0 no documenta actualmente API authentication.

context.p: Este tema cubre API-HEALTH-001, API-HEALTH-002, API-PROFILE-001, API-PROFILE-003, API-PROFILE-004, API-PROFILE-005, API-FF-001, API-VAL-001 y API-FF-002. Los ejemplos usan deliberadamente $BPM_BASE_URL, synthetic names, release-152, response assertions y disposable fixture IDs en vez de environment-specific hosts o secrets.

step.cmd: Cree una environment template reutilizable antes de copiar peticiones curl.

info.p: Request example: export BPM_BASE_URL="${BPM_BASE_URL:?set BPM_BASE_URL first}". Response example: el shell mantiene una base URL, schema channel, synthetic profile name y optional import path para toda la ejecución. Error example: el shell termina la asignación si falta un valor requerido.
info.codeblock:
# .env.devops-example.template BPM_BASE_URL= BPM_SCHEMA_CHANNEL=release-152 BPM_PROFILE_NAME=docs-api-example BPM_JSON_IMPORT_PATH=./policies.json
export BPM_BASE_URL="${BPM_BASE_URL:?set BPM_BASE_URL first}" export BPM_SCHEMA_CHANNEL="${BPM_SCHEMA_CHANNEL:-release-152}" export BPM_PROFILE_NAME="${BPM_PROFILE_NAME:-docs-api-example}" export BPM_JSON_IMPORT_PATH="${BPM_JSON_IMPORT_PATH:-./policies.json}"

step.cmd: Proteja cada secuencia reutilizable con probes de health y readiness.

info.p: Request example: curl -fsS "$BPM_BASE_URL/health" y curl -fsS "$BPM_BASE_URL/health/ready". Response example: {"status":"ok"} y {"status":"ready","ready":true}. Error example: curl devuelve non-zero para transport errors o non-2xx responses con -f.

step.cmd: Reutilice profile lifecycle snippets para create, list, read y guarded update.

info.p: Request example: POST $BPM_BASE_URL/api/profiles, GET $BPM_BASE_URL/api/profiles, GET $BPM_BASE_URL/api/profiles/$PROFILE_ID y PATCH $BPM_BASE_URL/api/profiles/$PROFILE_ID. Response example: 201 ProfileRead, 200 ProfileRead[], 200 ProfileRead y revision incrementada. Error examples: 400, 404, 409 stale expected_revision o 422.
info.codeblock:
PROFILE_JSON="$(curl -fsS -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ -d '{"name":"docs-api-example","schema_version":"release-152","flags":{"DisableTelemetry":true}}' \ "$BPM_BASE_URL/api/profiles")" PROFILE_ID="$(python -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["id"])' <<<"$PROFILE_JSON")" PROFILE_REVISION="$(python -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["revision"])' <<<"$PROFILE_JSON")"
curl -fsS "$BPM_BASE_URL/api/profiles?q=docs-api-example&lifecycle=active&limit=50&offset=0" curl -fsS "$BPM_BASE_URL/api/profiles/$PROFILE_ID" curl -fsS -X PATCH -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ -d "{\"flags\":{\"DisableTelemetry\":true,\"BlockAboutConfig\":true},\"expected_revision\":$PROFILE_REVISION}" \ "$BPM_BASE_URL/api/profiles/$PROFILE_ID"

step.cmd: Reutilice validation y JSON import snippets con forma explícita de payload.

info.p: Request example: POST $BPM_BASE_URL/api/validate/release-152 y POST $BPM_BASE_URL/api/profiles/import/firefox/policies.json. Response example: 200 {"ok":true,"profile":"release-152"} y 201 ProfileRead. Error examples: 400, 409, 415, 422 o 503.

step.cmd: Reutilice multipart import y export snippets para file-based handoff.

info.p: Request example: upload multipart/form-data a POST $BPM_BASE_URL/api/profiles/import/firefox/policies.json seguido de GET $BPM_BASE_URL/api/export/profiles/$PROFILE_ID/firefox/policies.json?pretty=1. Response example: 201 ProfileRead para import y 200 application/json con canonical Firefox policies para export. Error example: 404 missing profile o 422 invalid profile ID.

step.cmd: Use un Python helper compacto cuando la integración requiera reusable response assertions.

info.p: Request example: session.post(f"{base_url}/api/validate/{schema_channel}", json=payload, timeout=10). Response example: el helper falla inmediatamente salvo que status y JSON body coincidan con la assertion. Error example: assertion failures, timeout exceptions, stale expected_revision o structured API errors deben registrarse por el integrating product.
info.note: Conserve response status, profile ID, revision, schema channel, exported document hash y assertion result en evidencia externa. No copie real host names, secrets, API keys, secret values ni production identifiers en documentation examples.

result.p: El producto integrador dispone de reusable curl y Python examples seguros para copiar, independientes de deployment hosts, sincronizados con el BPM API behavior actual y vinculados a explicit response assertions.

postreq.p: Combine estos examples con los runbooks pull/list/read, validate-before-apply, import-review-export y failure-audit al crear workflows completos de control products externos.
